    Image-closed subcategories of the linear quiver (Theorem 5.5) #

    A subcategory C of the representations of 1 → 2 → ⋯ → n is image-closed iff its family of support intervals is intersection-closed: whenever M_{a,b} and M_{c,d} lie in C and [a, b] ∩ [c, d] ≠ ∅, the interval M_{max a c, min b d} lies in C.

    The proof follows the manuscript. For the forward direction the canonical morphism M_{c,d} ⟶ M_{a,b} has image M_{c,b} (Proposition 5.2). For the converse, an interval summand M_{a,b} of the image of f : X ⟶ Y is a quotient of X and a subobject of Y; by Lemma 5.3 and (5.1) it is a quotient of an interval M_{a,d} of C with b ≤ d and a subobject of an interval M_{c,b} of C with c ≤ a, so M_{a,b} = M_{a,d} ∩ M_{c,b} lies in C.
